name: 30072-transcription-whisperturbo-1gpu
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process vLLM engine on one GPU.
architecture: WhisperForConditionalGeneration, encoder-decoder, float16. 32 encoder layers and 4 decoder layers at d_model 1280, 128 mel bins, max_source_positions 1500, max_target_positions 448, vocab 51866 -- all in the checkpoint's config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), a three-point sweep at streams=6, then 16, then 32, each warming up the first 20% by completion and bounded at 800 requests with a 1800 s safety cap. 6 is the scored point.
workload: English speech transcription. guidellm `huggingface` data spec over openslr/librispeech_asr, name=clean, split=test -- 2620 read-aloud utterances, 16 kHz mono, one recording per request, mapped through `audio_column: audio`; 3 x 800 = 2400 requests is a single pass over the split, no repeats. The request carries no text: the prompt is the four Whisper decoder control tokens `<|startoftranscript|><|en|><|transcribe|><|notimestamps|>` and the audio. Greedy, temperature 0.0, no max_tokens and no ignore_eos, so each request stops when the transcription is finished; the split's transcripts run 24.5 output tokens on average.
purpose: An English speech-to-text service transcribing single short recordings per request, 6 to 32 concurrent streams, one GPU.
launch:
model: openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: float16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
# The value on the source's own published benchmark command, carried over verbatim.
#
# Do not read more into it than that. At this engine commit it does NOT widen how many clips
# the scheduler may admit per step: for an encoder-decoder model the engine overwrites
# `max_num_encoder_input_tokens` with the model's own encoder length (1500 for Whisper) AFTER
# SchedulerConfig has derived it from this key, so the per-step encoder compute budget is 1500
# -- exactly one clip -- whatever this is set to. What the key does still size is the per-step
# token budget (default 2048) and the encoder cache (84 MB here). Measured, not assumed:
# `encoder_compute_budget = max(max_num_encoder_input_tokens, 1500)`.
max-num-batched-tokens: 32874
